description: Hey! we are Pentatech from Ghana, passionate about coding, AI,and solving real-world problems.Our NASA Space Apps focus is using satellite data and AI to help farmers plan better crop rotations, improve soil health, and tackle climate challenges.We have skills in Python, web development, and UI/UX design.We're looking for creative teammates into GIS, data science, agriculture, AI, and design. You don't need to be an expert, just passionate, curious, and ready to build something amazing together!
